_description: Default configuration for CITE-seq 50D PCA dataset training. Apples-to-apples eval with MFM (src/experiments/baselines/metric-flow-matching/mfm/flow_matchers/flow_net_train.py): full per-timepoint data via ot.emd2 (eval_num_samples=null matches MFM's test_dataloader using batch_size=frame_data.shape[0]). traj_skips=20 (10 evals/run instead of 41) + eval_metrics drops 'fgd' (FGD is in fact free at <0.25s/eval on a 50x50 cov matrix, but we no longer need it since best-epoch selection falls back to W1 at holdout times). The remaining per-eval cost is dominated by W1 + W2 + MMD (each CPU-bound at ~20-90s per eval).
